# Command Reference

[← Docs index](../../README.md)

One page per command in `Scripts/bin`, generated from its `--help`. Every page is also
available in the terminal as `<command> -h`.

## AI

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| [claude_tool](claude_tool.md) | Run every file in a directory through Claude with a prompt template. |
| [llm_chat](llm_chat.md) | Interactive chat with a local or cloud LLM, seeded with a prompt and files. |
| [ollama_tool](ollama_tool.md) | Find, pull and manage Ollama models sized to this machine, and run a coding agent on one. |

## Audio & Video

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| [audio_conversion_tool](audio_conversion_tool.md) | Convert Audible AAX and AA audiobooks to M4A. |
| [audio_metadata_tool](audio_metadata_tool.md) | Extract, clear or apply the tags of albums in the local locker's music tree. |
| [download_audio_files](download_audio_files.md) | Download new videos from a genre's configured channels as MP3 and back them up to a locker. |
| [download_youtube_videos](download_youtube_videos.md) | Download a video, playlist or channel with yt-dlp as MP4 or MP3. |
| [generate_playlist](generate_playlist.md) | Write `.m3u` playlists for the media files in a directory tree. |
| [tag_audio_files](tag_audio_files.md) | Tag audio files with the right per-genre defaults, then apply them in one run. |

## Backups & Lockers

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| [backup_game_files](backup_game_files.md) | Download store purchases whose build has changed and upload them, encrypted, to a locker. |
| [backup_tool](backup_tool.md) | Copy, encrypt, decrypt or archive a directory tree into another directory. |
| [crypt_tool](crypt_tool.md) | Encrypt or decrypt files in place with GPG. |
| [find_missing_hash_sidecars](find_missing_hash_sidecars.md) | List files on a remote locker that have no entry in its hash sidecar database. |
| [github_tool](github_tool.md) | Archive your GitHub repositories into the locker, or sync your forks with upstream. |
| [locker_hash_tool](locker_hash_tool.md) | Record the XXH3 hash, size and modification time of every file in a locker directory. |
| [locker_sync_tool](locker_sync_tool.md) | Sync a primary locker to one or more secondary lockers, reviewing each change in an editor. |
| [master_backup](master_backup.md) | Back up the local locker to one or more remote lockers in one unattended run. |
| [rebuild_hash_sidecars](rebuild_hash_sidecars.md) | Rebuild a remote locker's hash sidecar database from local content. |
| [run_presets](run_presets.md) | Run another JoyBox tool once per platform of a named preset group. |
| [sync_tool](sync_tool.md) | Run an rclone operation between the local locker and a remote locker. |
| [upload_game_files](upload_game_files.md) | Encrypt game folders in place and upload them to a remote locker. |

## Files & Archives

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| [check_computer_archives](check_computer_archives.md) | Find Windows executables that are larger than 4092 MB. |
| [clean_exif_data](clean_exif_data.md) | Strip all EXIF and other embedded metadata from image files. |
| [compress_files](compress_files.md) | Compress each file in a directory into an archive of its own with 7-Zip. |
| [compress_folders](compress_folders.md) | Compress each folder in a directory into an archive of its own with 7-Zip. |
| [decompress_archives](decompress_archives.md) | Extract archive files into a folder beside each archive. |
| [list_dupes](list_dupes.md) | List duplicate files under a directory. |
| [make_folders](make_folders.md) | Move each matching file into a folder of its own, named after the file. |
| [rezip_files](rezip_files.md) | Rebuild zip files in place with fixed, reproducible 7-Zip settings. |
| [sanitize_filenames](sanitize_filenames.md) | Rename files so their names are plain ASCII and safe on every filesystem. |
| [verify_archives](verify_archives.md) | Test archive files for corruption with 7-Zip. |

## Game Collection

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| [analyze_game_json_files](analyze_game_json_files.md) | List games whose JSON file has no files, or whose metadata marks them unplayable. |
| [build_game_hash_files](build_game_hash_files.md) | Record hashes of each selected game's files in the per-subcategory hash file. |
| [build_game_json_files](build_game_json_files.md) | Create or update the JSON file of each game found in a locker. |
| [build_game_metadata_files](build_game_metadata_files.md) | Add each game with a JSON file to its platform's Pegasus metadata file and fill in missing details. |
| [build_game_store_purchases](build_game_store_purchases.md) | Import the games you own on a store as JSON and metadata entries, and refresh the existing ones. |
| [clean_game_hash_files](clean_game_hash_files.md) | Rewrite every game hash file with its entries in sorted order. |
| [clean_game_json_files](clean_game_json_files.md) | Tidy every game JSON file: sort its keys and drop empty values. |
| [clean_game_metadata_files](clean_game_metadata_files.md) | Rewrite every platform's Pegasus metadata file with its entries in sorted order. |
| [download_game_metadata_assets](download_game_metadata_assets.md) | Download one kind of artwork or video for each selected game and back it up to the lockers. |
| [find_missing_game_assets](find_missing_game_assets.md) | Compare the games in the Pegasus metadata with the asset files in the local locker. |
| [find_missing_game_metadata](find_missing_game_metadata.md) | Find games whose Pegasus metadata entries are missing fields. |
| [login_game_stores](login_game_stores.md) | Log in to the selected game stores so their purchases, metadata and downloads can be fetched. |
| [publish_game_metadata_files](publish_game_metadata_files.md) | Render the Pegasus metadata as one browsable HTML table per category. |
| [scan_game_files](scan_game_files.md) | Run the whole collection pipeline: store purchases, JSON files, metadata, optional assets, and HTML publishing. |
| [sort_game_metadata](sort_game_metadata.md) | Rewrite every Pegasus metadata file found under the metadata repository in sorted order. |
| [verify_game_files](verify_game_files.md) | Check that game JSON, metadata and hash files agree with the files in the local locker. |

## Game Launching

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| [install_game_json](install_game_json.md) | Install a game described by its JSON file into the local game cache. |
| [launch_game_json](launch_game_json.md) | Launch a game described by its JSON file, installing it and restoring its save first. |
| [launch_pegasus](launch_pegasus.md) | Start the Pegasus game frontend installed by setup_tools. |
| [launch_sunshine](launch_sunshine.md) | Start the Sunshine game-streaming host installed by setup_tools. |

## Game ROMs & Images

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| [3ds_rom_tool](3ds_rom_tool.md) | Convert, trim, untrim, extract or inspect Nintendo 3DS CIA and CCI (.3ds) files. |
| [chdconvert](chdconvert.md) | Convert CD disc images (ISO, CUE, GDI) to CHD files with chdman. |
| [chdextract](chdextract.md) | Extract CD disc images from CHD files with chdman. |
| [chdverify](chdverify.md) | Check CHD files against their internal SHA-1 checksums with chdman. |
| [chdzip](chdzip.md) | Repack the files on each CHD disc image into a zip archive. |
| [dat_renamer](dat_renamer.md) | Rename ROM files to the names a DAT file gives them, matching by MD5. |
| [isoextract](isoextract.md) | Extract the files from ISO images into a folder beside each image. |
| [make_iso](make_iso.md) | Build an ISO image from each folder, or each zip file, in a directory. |
| [nds_rom_tool](nds_rom_tool.md) | Decrypt or encrypt Nintendo DS ROMs in place with NDecrypt. |
| [ps3_rom_tool](ps3_rom_tool.md) | Check that PlayStation 3 disc CHDs decrypt and extract with their disc keys. |
| [psn_rom_tool](psn_rom_tool.md) | Rename PlayStation Network packages and license files to their content IDs. |
| [psv_rom_tool](psv_rom_tool.md) | Strip, unstrip, trim, untrim or verify PlayStation Vita cartridge dumps (.psv). |
| [switch_rom_tool](switch_rom_tool.md) | Trim or untrim Nintendo Switch cartridge images (.xci). |
| [wiiu_rom_tool](wiiu_rom_tool.md) | Decrypt or test-decrypt Nintendo Wii U NUS packages. |
